description_target.target_text: draw 3x3 box of 1s around each 2 that sits inside the bbox of a 3-component (skipping cells that are themselves interior 2s)

racket_target.raw_code: (rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let* ((three-objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3)) (objects g 0))) (interior-2s (apply append (map (lambda (o) (with-bbox o (r1 c1 r2 c2) (let* ((valid (for/and ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1)))) (for/and ((c (range c1 (+ c2 1)))) (let ((v (at g r c))) (or (= v 3) (= v 2))))))) (if valid (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range c1 (+ c2 1))) #:when (= (at g r c) 2)) (list r c)) ' ())))) three-objs))) (interior-set (make-hash)) (_1 (for ((p interior-2s)) (hash-set! interior-set (list (first p) (second p)) #t)))) (for/fold ((out g)) ((p interior-2s)) (let ((pr (first p)) (pc (second p))) (for*/fold ((gg out)) ((dr (in-list ' (-1 0 1))) (dc (in-list ' (-1 0 1)))) (let ((r (+ pr dr)) (c (+ pc dc))) (cond ((or (< r 0) (>= r h) (< c 0) (>= c w)) gg) ((hash-has-key? interior-set (list r c)) gg) (else (set-cell gg r c 1)))))))))))
